title: Documentary project with secret dating evidence

tellings.quote: I am part of a very significant documentary that I'm leading

plain: In 2024, a man named Matt LaCroix says he is leading "a very significant documentary" filmed at ancient sites in Turkey, Peru, Bolivia and Minorca, with new dating evidence he is keeping secret for now. He names people working with him, including Robert Schoch, Robert Edward Grant, Arturo Ponce de Leon and Paul Wallace. LaCroix tells it as his own project, and if the evidence holds it would push these sites back to around 12,000 BC, much older than usually thought.
